objective.baseline: matched command and initial task state
objective.horizon: complete terminated or truncated locomotion episode
objective.evidence_scope: raw command, tracking outcomes, episode length and termination reason

relations.condition: same command and comparable tracking before failure
relations.right: trajectory that terminates early by falling

relations.condition: zero velocity command and equal physical validity
relations.left: lower linear and angular velocity tracking error
relations.right: higher linear or angular velocity tracking error

relations.condition: same nonzero velocity command and equal physical validity
relations.left: lower linear and angular velocity tracking error
relations.right: higher linear or angular velocity tracking error

incomparable_cases.left: lower tracking error with worse unconfirmed motion style
incomparable_cases.right: higher tracking error with better unconfirmed motion style
incomparable_cases.reason: v016 confirms no total priority over unmeasured style
